purpose: Small, strict command contract for designing, auditing, fixing and compiling websites without repository crawling or prompt aliases.

authority.creative: The user's design conversation owns art direction. /ideate never authorizes redesign by itself and must resolve final, enhancement or redesign authority before creative work.
authority.conversion: Only seam.kiwe emits production Bricks JSON. /convert /bricks returns a guarded binding graph and report; approved source files remain unchanged.
authority.siteContext: SiteGraph is an attached or connected input and carries embedded Design Context; neither is a slash command.
authority.framework: Seam Framework is an explicit seam.kiwe compilation option, never an automatic rewrite.

requires: project request or inspectable attachments; explicit source authority for an existing design; SiteGraph only when preflight proves it is required
user says proceed after reviewing the usage brief and production-content readiness preflight; supplying SiteGraph or another requested attachment is not proceed
outputs: Design Context coverage report before modification
page-relevant Design Context and Design Content usage brief
complete browser-smoke-tested raw HTML/CSS/JS project after approval
commands.boundary: Inspect attachments and resolve whether an existing design is final, enhancement-authorized or redesign-authorized before SiteGraph or creative work; after any requested evidence arrives, emit and pause on the grounded usage brief. Production output may not retain placeholders when sufficient SiteGraph or approved-source context exists, and must fail closed on runtime errors. Attachments never grant approval and /ideate alone never grants redesign permission.

requires: complete accepted raw HTML/CSS/JS project, kept unchanged
SiteGraph when site-specific fields are requested
commands.boundary: Binding-only handoff with sourcePolicy immutable, exact per-file targets, explicit field slots, source guards and repeat prototypes. Never rewrite source or emit Bricks JSON.
Read only. Never modify the submitted artifact.
Audit only. Use /fix to create a changed artifact.
Apply only proven findings and preserve art direction, content and behavior.
Discard the failed output as authority; return to the last accepted artifact.

cachePolicy: Fetch the versioned manifest advertised by entry.json. Do not reuse a different contract version from conversation memory.
